create_discriminator_model: create a Discriminator model with configurable in_channels, hidden_channels, and depth parameters
build_conditional_discriminator: build a conditional Discriminator that accepts an additional cond_channels conditioning tensor
run_discriminator_forward: run the Discriminator forward pass on an input tensor with optional conditioning
configure_discriminator_depth: configure a Discriminator with custom depth and hidden_channels for deeper or shallower architectures
test_discriminator_spectral_norm: test the Discriminator encoder layers that use spectral_norm and InstanceNorm2d with LeakyReLU activations
